blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court on Tuesday denied the House prosecution panel’s request to admit Vice President Sara Duterte’s bank records as evidence. It cited the Bill of Rights, particularly the right against self-incrimination. This came after the House prosecution panel submitted a request for admission on Sept. 8 covering Duterte’s personal circumstances […]...
